description: A complete cooking recipe extracted from a cooking-tutorial video, including ingredients with quantities, the ordered cooking process, and tips.

dish.description: Name of the dish (transliterate to the Latin alphabet if the video is not in English)

title_bn.description: The dish name in its original script (e.g. Bengali / Devanagari), exactly as spoken or shown on screen, if the video is not in English

servings.description: How many it serves, or what it is served with, if stated

ingredients.description: Every ingredient with its exact quantity as spoken in the narration or shown on screen.

quantity.description: Exact amount with unit (e.g. '250 g', '1 tsp', '2 medium'); 'to taste' / 'as needed' if that is what was said

group.description: Optional sub-grouping if the recipe separates them (e.g. 'marinade', 'gravy', 'tempering')

seconds.description: Timestamp in seconds where the step starts

action.description: What to do in this step

time_minutes.description: Cooking/resting time for this step in minutes, if stated

tips.description: Techniques or tips the cook gives for a better result. For EACH tip, record the timestamp (seconds) in the video where the advice is spoken/shown, or where the action it refers to happens — so it can be attached to the right step.

seconds.description: Timestamp in seconds where the tip is given, or where the action it refers to happens

hero_shot.description: The single most visually appealing moment to screenshot as a recipe-card hero image — ideally the finished, fully plated dish, well-lit and complete. IMPORTANT: pick a CLEAN frame with the food unobstructed; avoid any moment showing end-screen / 'subscribe' / 'thanks for watching' / channel-logo / text overlays (these usually appear in the closing seconds), and avoid frames with hands, utensils, or motion blur across the dish.

seconds.description: Timestamp in seconds of that best frame

reason.description: What is shown and why it is the best hero frame
